name: Clipboard Shelf
description:
Clipboard Shelf turns CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a touch-first Windows text clipboard history. Recent entries appear as readable cards with a clear CURRENT indicator; tap any card to copy it again.

Pin recurring snippets, mark favorites, recognize URLs, search on larger layouts, delete individual entries with confirmation, or clear history safely. Long and multiline text stay readable, and very large entries preserve their full local copy data while sending only a bounded display preview.

Private Mode pauses capture and hides existing history. If Windows switches to an image, file, or other non-text clipboard item, CURRENT clears instead of becoming stale.

Continuous history uses the free local Clipboard Shelf Bridge:
https://github.com/slayerkey/rp-system/releases/download/clipboard-shelf-bridge-v1.0.0/PackRat-Clipboard-Shelf-Bridge-1.0.0-win-x64.zip

Run the bridge once; it installs for the current Windows user and starts with Windows. Copy its locally generated pairing code from the tray icon into Clipboard Shelf settings in iCUE. History is never exposed before pairing succeeds.

The bridge is loopback-only, protects local state with Windows DPAPI, and sends no clipboard contents to PackRat servers, cloud sync, analytics, or CI logs. v1 is intentionally text-only.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
• Readable recent Windows text clipboard cards with one-tap copy
• Pins, favorites, URL recognition, filters, and long-text handling
• Secure per-user bridge pairing, automatic reconnect, and Windows startup
• Configurable local history with individual delete and confirmed clear-all
• Private Mode pauses capture and hides clipboard text on the display
• Eight tuned XENEON Edge layouts with accurate CURRENT state
